concern_summary: This concern focuses on the overall concierge service functionalities, including checking reports related to concierge chats, managing user interactions within the concierge service interface, ensuring user authentication, and handling access restrictions based on user status.

This concern addresses user access management related to concierge services, specifically checking if users are blocked from accessing concierge functionalities and managing the display of related options based on their blocked status.
This concern involves retrieving and displaying the latest error messages related to reimbursement accounts or other account-specific issues that require user attention.
This concern is centered around handling error messages related to reimbursement accounts, particularly in displaying feedback when issues arise that could affect user actions.

This concern focuses on managing the presentation of error messages and a generic error page, ensuring users are informed about errors, can refresh or sign out, and receive guidance on travel-related issues.

This concern relates to handling error pages that display unique error messages for receipt-related issues. It processes specific error messages and validates them to ensure they pertain to receipt errors, providing a cohesive way to inform users about problems and their potential resolutions.
This concern involves displaying appropriate not found pages related to transactions and subscription size, ensuring users receive correct information about unavailable resources.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to displaying and managing error messages across various user actions and scenarios, ensuring users are informed of issues like transaction failures, form validation errors, and account-related discrepancies.
Management of onboarding error messages displayed to users when they encounter issues during the onboarding process.
This concern focuses on managing and clearing errors associated with various payment methods, ensuring that the error states are properly reset.
